selection.sampleMethod: Uniform sample without replacement from all non-nullified run/pass snaps with saved frames; no outcome filters or rerolls. Selected before inspecting these plays. Light recordings cannot establish hidden perception or forces.
selection.ordering: Game files lexical; log rows in saved order; Python random.Random(20261011).sample(pool,48).
selection.poolFilter: kind run/pass, recorded frames present, nullified false; no gain/result/concept filters
selection.reviewers: Two engineering agents, 24 plays each, plus primary spot checks. Not an independent expert coach panel. Selection preceded reviewing outcomes; reviewers were not strictly outcome-blinded.

rubric: docs/VALIDATION.md: responsibility; available evidence; achievable approach; coherent contact; timely/legal next action. Light positions, facing, ball, calls and events only.

negativeFindings.examples: G7-P109 retreats before throwing; G3-P068 throws away near late proximity. G2-P136 brakes before a missed tackle. Do not count those as frozen/never-braking defects.

limits: These are descriptive concern counts, not bug rates or a league ranking. Hidden decisions, grip/ground loads and achieved support are absent. Denominators count reviewed eligible play types, not all tackle/pull opportunities. Limited generated rosters and small sample; do not claim physics readiness.
